## Appearance

Matthew Cuthbert is an odd-looking, ungainly man with long iron-gray hair that reaches his stooping shoulders. He has kindly brown eyes, a placid face, and a full, soft brown beard that he has worn since he was twenty years old.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)_

## Personality

A remarkably shy and quiet individual, he dreads strangers and experiences an intense discomfort around women, fearing they are secretly laughing at him. He particularly suffers from a mortal dread of little girls, though he generally prefers talkative companions who are willing to lead conversations. Beyond his introverted nature, he is wise, patient, and good-natured, making him a sympathetic listener who never scolds. He is extremely hardworking and does not seek out excitement. Though not one for arguments, he is quietly persistent, clinging firmly to his opinions and whims once set upon them.

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with his sister, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), having worn a full brown beard continuously since he was twenty years old. When he and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) decided to adopt an orphan boy, Matthew drove to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) to pick him up, only to find that eleven-year-old [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) had been sent by mistake. Though he left the decision of handling the error to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), he enjoyed listening to Anne's excited chatter on the ride home and tentatively suggested keeping her. As [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepared to return the girl, Matthew quietly made his desire to keep [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) clear. Throughout her childhood, Matthew remained a supportive presence, secretly persuading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to apologize to Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) after a quarrel, giving her chocolates, and convincing [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let her attend a [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert. Realizing Anne's plain clothes set her apart, he arranged with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to get her a fashionable dress with puffed sleeves for Christmas. When a severe case of croup struck [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), Matthew rode off to fetch a doctor while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) nursed the child. Years later, he warmly encouraged Anne's participation in school festivities and took great pride in her performance at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), where she tied for first place on the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams and won the Avery scholarship. Shortly after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returned home from Queen's, Matthew collapsed and died from the shock of reading about the failure of the Abbey Bank.

> "It’ll have to be done sooner or later, you know, for Marilla’s a dreadful determined woman—dreadful determined, Anne. Do it right off, I say, and have it over."
>

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--matthew-cuthbert.md)

Matthew and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are the best of friends, forming a quick bond despite initial complications regarding her arrival at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Matthew quiet advocate for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), secretly visiting her to offer advice during punishments and frequently treating her to chocolates. He consistently signals his desire to keep [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at the farm, standing in contrast to Marilla's strictness.
